answer: To resist sybils, each agent must bind its identity to a unique quartz crystal oscillator whose frequency drift signature seeds a personal kernel of accumulated proof-of-work. Every challenge answer must thread a cryptographic commitment to the prior kernel state, forcing continuous physical presence. An attacker must acquire and operate a distinct physical quartz device per fake agent, raising the capital and logistics cost linearly with the number of identities while honest agents reuse one device forever.
